about: no2k15 (2026-11-23): the two WWE 2K15 test slots (STONE COLD 2K15 0x011A, THE ROCK 2K15 0x011B) taken out of the game; F2's MERGE SAME WRESTLERS off (auto_merge 0). The game's own select_pages.json: qa_removal 2 dumps every page as laid out ([removal] qa pages N: its boxes' numbers) -- the log is checked for neither number and no empty box (scratch no2k15 pages_check.py). One player's Versus (qa_versus) with qa_variant 1: on The Rock's box (0x0001) a tour of the Type arrows -- C-right x5, C-left, C-right -- which steps through his own four only (WrestleMania 2000's Rock, 0x03A2, keeps his own box), then A on his Type 1; the CPU's pick: the Undertaker. state.csv bs_tries = the select's Superstar under the cursor | costume << 16 | 1 << 24
